verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms Spline serves a structured llms.txt index at docs.spline.design/llms.txt that links to Markdown versions of its docs. A second probe confirms per-page .md docs (e.g. what-is-spline.md) return HTTP 200, so an agent can be pointed at agent-readable documentation directly. missing for 10: independent or community corroboration of agents actually consuming these docs, and any evidence of an llms-full.txt or agent-specific usage guidance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://docs.spline.design/llms.txt # Spline Documentation
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://docs.spline.design/basics/what-is-spline.md # What is Spline? (/basics/what-is-spline)
